_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
I nih Player {player_id} Tic Tac Toe-ah.
I tum ber chu board-ah thuma chhinchhiahna ( horizontal, vertical, emaw diagonal) hawn theih tur a ni.
I turn-ah, i duhna square number (0-8) i thlang ang a, i mark dahna tur a ni.
Entirnan, '[4]' i mark chu board center cell-ah a dah ang.
Player {player_id} i nih chuan, i ni '{symbol}' a, i opponent chu '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A thawn chhuah chu a format dik lo.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} hi cell dik a ni lo. 0 leh 8 inkârah awm tûr a ni.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} chuan an symbol ({symbol}) cell {cell}-ah an dah.
